import subprocess

def run(comp):
    p = subprocess.run(['./test_runner'], input=comp, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

cases = [
    (b'\x00', 0, b'', 'empty block'),
    (b'\x50hello', 0, b'hello', 'literal only'),
    (b'\x12a\x01\x00', 0, b'a'*7, 'overlapping match'),
    (b'\xf0\x00' + b'A'*15, 0, b'A'*15, '15 literals via extension'),
    (b'\xf0\x04' + b'B'*19, 0, b'B'*19, '19 literals via extension'),
    (b'\x1fa\x01\x00\x02\x00', 0, b'a'*22, 'extended match length'),
    (b'', 1, b'', 'zero-length input should fail'),
    (b'\x10a\x00\x00', 1, b'', 'zero offset should fail'),
    (b'\x10a\x01', 1, b'', 'truncated offset should fail'),
    (b'\x1fa\x01\x00\xff', 1, b'', 'truncated match length should fail'),
]

ok = True
for comp, exp_rc, exp_out, name in cases:
    rc, out, err = run(comp)
    passed = (rc == exp_rc and out == exp_out)
    print(('PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'), name, 'rc=', rc, 'out_len=', len(out))
    if not passed:
        print('  expected rc', exp_rc, 'out_len', len(exp_out))
        print('  stderr:', err)
        ok = False

print('ALL PASS' if ok else 'SOME FAILED')
